description: Canonical quality scoring dimensions for BTE Knowledge Records and related artifacts. Specification only — no scoring engine runtime.

metrics.name: Completeness
metrics.description: All required KR sections, fields, and checklist items are present and non-empty where mandatory.

metrics.name: Consistency
metrics.description: Internal consistency of names, classifications, definitions, and cross-section statements within the record.

metrics.name: Traceability
metrics.description: Assertions and claims are traceable to bibliography sources (SRC-*) and review decisions.

metrics.name: Compiler Compatibility
metrics.description: Record structure and IDs are compatible with compiler artifact contracts and standards KR schema expectations.

metrics.name: Relationship Integrity
metrics.description: Declared relationships use approved types, valid endpoints, and non-duplicate links.

metrics.name: Bibliography Integrity
metrics.description: All cited SRC-* IDs exist in bibliography SSOT; citation rules are followed; no invented sources.

metrics.name: Graph Integrity
metrics.description: Graph projection respects node/edge ontology and constraints (acyclicity, unique canonical node, immutable IDs, no duplicate edges).

metrics.name: Governance Compliance
metrics.description: Academic, technical, and governance reviews, approval, and freeze states comply with canon policy.

notes: Weights are defaults for overall rollup; scorecards may override weights within their scope.
Sprint 3C defines metrics only; no automated scorer is shipped.
